brand_identity.name: StackForge
brand_identity.logo_concept: Monospaced Text with a blinking cursor underscore

headings.usage: All section headers, panel titles, and prominent stats. Gives the 'IDE' feel.

body.usage: General UI text, descriptions, form labels.

code.usage: Terminal output, code snippets, file paths.

colors.gradients: NONE. Use solid colors only as per 'No fancy gradients' constraint.

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#002480] rounded-sm px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#111827] border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-sm px-6 py-2.5 font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.ghost: text-[#4B5563] hover:text-[#111827] hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-900 rounded-sm focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#002FA7] placeholder:text-gray-400 h-10 px-3
inputs.label: text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5 block

terminal_panel.style: bg-[#0F172A] text-white font-mono p-4 rounded-sm border border-gray-800 h-full overflow-y-auto
terminal_panel.cursor: inline-block w-2.5 h-5 bg-[#22C55E] animate-pulse ml-1 align-middle

configurator_layout.left_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 border-r border-gray-200 p-6 bg-gray-50/50 overflow-y-auto
configurator_layout.right_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 bg-[#0F172A] text-gray-300 p-6 font-mono text-sm overflow-y-auto

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Use borders to define structure instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle. shadow-sm for active elements only. Flat design preferred.
visual_enhancers.textures: None. Pure flat colors for 'clean' aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React icons. Stroke width 1.5px for elegance.

hero_background.desc: Minimalist blue/white abstract geometry for hero section background (low opacity)

student_coding.desc: Clean silver MacBook setup, representing the 'Student' workspace

team_collaboration.desc: Two students/devs collaborating, for 'About' or 'Community' section

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 3-panel layout for the dashboard.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all headings to give the 'Developer Tool' vibe.
Do not use gradients. Use solid colors and 1px borders for separation.
The Right Panel (Terminal) must always be in Dark Mode (#0F172A), even if the rest of the app is Light Mode.
Use Shadcn UI components but override the rounded corners to 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none' for a technical look.
Ensure the 'Generate Project' button is the most prominent element on the screen (International Klein Blue).
Dynamic Field Builder: Use a table-like layout where users can add rows for 'Field Name', 'Type' (String, Int, Boolean), and 'Required' (Checkbox).
Stack Selector: Use Radio Group Cards (Selectable cards with icons).

accessibility_guidelines.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Gray text on white must be #4B5563 or darker.
accessibility_guidelines.focus_states: Visible focus rings (blue) for keyboard navigation.

universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
